data.title: 新垣绫濑 · 晨光微曦的完美娇妻依偎
data.description: 初升朝阳穿透白纱倾泻在凌乱床单上。香汗未干的绫濑整个人贴在你的胸膛前，纤细指尖温柔抚弄着你的发丝，满面红晕地轻声互诉晨安，沉浸在圆满新婚的无上幸福中。
data.location: sunlit master bedroom with soft billowing white curtains
data.action: tangled deeply in white morning sheets with flushed bare back and shoulders exposed, gently stroking partner hair with a tender teary smile, whispering morning vows
data.lighting: bright golden morning sunlight illuminating porcelain skin and tangled sheets
data.mood: ultimate romantic fulfillment, peaceful matrimonial bliss, unconditional love
data.promptProse: Tangled in white morning sheets with bare shoulders, Ayase Aragaki gently strokes partner hair with a tender tearful smile in bright golden sun.
